home.kicker: six crafts, twelve workshops, one archive
home.headline: Hear the hands before they go quiet.
home.lede: VanishingTrades keeps the stories of Karnataka's endangered crafts in the makers' own voices, puts buyers in touch with the makers directly, and finds them apprentices.
home.marginNote: every story is checked by a person before it goes up
home.fadingTitle: Six crafts, slowly losing their colour
home.fadingNote: Scroll, hover or tab to each one. The colour comes back when someone pays attention.
home.storyTitle: What happens to a story here

record.title: Record it
record.body: An artisan speaks into a phone, in Kannada, Hindi or English. The recording, a transcript and an English translation go to a human reviewer, who checks every line before anything is public.
record.goal: This is target 11.4 of the Global Goals: protect the world's cultural heritage. A craft is mostly knowledge, and knowledge lives in people.

keep.title: Keep it
keep.body: Each artisan has a profile with their work and prices. Buyers write to them directly, with nobody in between taking a cut. A craft survives when it pays.
keep.goal: Goal 8 is decent work. The fastest way to keep a craft alive is a fair order.

pass.title: Pass it on
pass.body: Artisans post apprenticeships. Learners apply, follow a five-step roadmap, keep a progress log and finish with a certificate anyone can check.
pass.goal: Goal 4 is quality education. Some of the best teachers here never went to college.

home.latestBody: Stories go up once a reviewer has read every line.

gallery.title: The gallery
gallery.lede: Pieces made by hand in Karnataka, listed by the people who made them. Prices are set by the artisan. Write to them directly.
gallery.note: nothing here was made by a machine, including the pictures

enquiry.title: Write to {{name}}
enquiry.lede: Your message goes straight to the artisan. Say what you would like and when you need it.
enquiry.subject: Subject
enquiry.messageHint: Quantities, colours, dates. The more specific, the better the reply.
enquiry.sentBody: Replies arrive on your workbench. Artisans are often at the wheel or the loom, so give it a day or two.
enquiry.signInFirst: Sign in as a buyer to send an enquiry.
enquiry.buyersOnly: Enquiries come from buyer accounts. Artisans and learners can reach out through the apprenticeship pages.

archive.title: The story archive
archive.lede: Artisans telling their crafts in their own languages. Each story was transcribed, translated, and then read line by line by a reviewer before going up.
archive.note: headphones help; the looms are loud

player.label: Player for {{title}}
player.keys: Keys: Space plays or pauses, arrows skip 5 seconds, M mutes. Nothing plays until you press Play.
player.sampleAudio: No real recording exists for this demo story. You will hear a soft placeholder hum.
player.noAudio: This story was written down rather than recorded.
player.unplayable: This recording only lived in the browser that made it, so it cannot play here.
player.cannotPlay: This browser could not play the recording. Try another browser, or read the transcript.
player.sampleAi: This translation was made by the sample AI, not a person or a real model.

appr.title: Apprenticeships
appr.lede: Artisans who want to pass their craft on. Openings are paid where the artisan can manage it, and every finished apprenticeship ends with a certificate anyone can check.
appr.note: patience is the only real entry requirement
appr.motivation: Why this craft, and why you?
appr.motivationHint: A few honest sentences are enough. Mention when you can come.
appr.appliedBody: The artisan will read it and shortlist, accept or decline. You can follow it on your workbench.
appr.closedNote: This opening is closed. Keep an eye on the list for the next one.
appr.signInToApply: Sign in as a learner to apply.

roadmapHint.tools: Name, hold and care for each tool.
roadmapHint.materials: Gather, clean and ready the raw material.
roadmapHint.technique: Repeat the main movement until it is steady.
roadmapHint.first-piece: Make one piece from start to finish.
roadmapHint.showcase: Present it to the artisan and a visitor.

impact.title: Impact, grouped by goal
impact.lede: What has happened on VanishingTrades so far, counted straight from the database and grouped under the three Global Goals the project works toward.
impact.sampleNote: Everything counted here is demo data, so these are sample numbers.

why.sdg8: Artisans earning from their craft, through direct enquiries.
why.sdg11: Stories kept in the public archive, in the languages they were told in.
why.sdg4: Learners taking up the craft through apprenticeships.

chart.sdg4: Applications and certificates, last six months

verify.title: Check a certificate
verify.lede: Every finished apprenticeship gets a code. Type it in to see the certificate it belongs to.
verify.notFoundHint: Check for a mixed-up 0 and O, or 1 and I. Codes never use those letters.
verify.completed: completed {{title}}, {{weeks}} weeks of {{craft}}, at the bench and in good faith.

myStories.title: My stories
myStories.emptyHint: Start with something small: who taught you, or the first piece you made.

editor.newLede: Give it a title and pick the language you will tell it in. You can record or type it on the next screen.
editor.title: Title
editor.textHint: Type the story here if you prefer writing to recording.
editor.recordLede: Press Record and talk as you would to a visitor at your bench. You can pause, listen back, and record again.
editor.hasAudio: A recording of {{secs}} seconds is saved with this story.
editor.aiLede: The AI writes down what you said, translates it into English and drafts a short summary. You check it in the next step.
editor.aiWorking: Listening carefully and winding the words onto the spool…
editor.aiDone: Transcript and translation are ready to check.
editor.aiSample: This text came from the sample AI. Please correct it before you send it for review.
editor.reviewLede: Correct anything the AI misheard. A reviewer reads it next.
editor.tagsHint: Separate with commas, for example: family, lac
editor.noSegments: Nothing here yet. Process the recording, or add a line.
editor.pendingNote: This story is with a reviewer. You can edit it again if it comes back.
editor.approvedNote: This story is in the public archive.
